id: title:clr182:refetch tickets when opening the my tickets page

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application ticket display and refresh behavior
review.reason: Adds a scene-scoped ticket loading mechanism, replacing shared sidepanel logic, allowing ticket data to refresh when navigating to the My Tickets page rather than only when the side panel is opened.
review.uncertainty: This is a frontend-only change; no backend, database, or shared dependency changes are supplied.
